posts.title: A beginner’s guide to the Jenesis build tool
posts.description: Introduction In this article, I’m going to show you how we can build the Hypersistence Utils project with Jenesis, a new Java build tool created by Rafael Winterhalter, who’s a Java Champion, author of Byte Buddy and a major contributor to Mockito. If you haven’t heard of it yet, check out this introductory article first. What is Jenesis Jenesis is a build tool whose engine is just plain Java code
